project.name: PicksZone
project.description: Premium, modern sports betting predictions platform and internal prop betting app with a community and comprehensive admin panel.
project.vibe: Elite athleticism, precision, command-center focus, tactical minimalism.

typography.strategy: High-contrast geometric athleticism for a premium sportsbook feel.

headings.usage: Hero texts, section headers, massive data numbers.

body.usage: General body copy, UI text, descriptions.

monospace.usage: Odds tables, metrics, virtual coin balances, tipster yields.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none font-black
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight uppercase font-bold

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Tactical Minimalism. Optimize for density in tables and dashboard grids, but use generous padding inside cards to prevent clutter.

surfaces.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-zinc-800 text-white rounded-md focus:border-[#007AFF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#007AFF]

components.strategy: Shadcn for interactive elements heavily customized to remove light-mode Vercel aesthetics. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for bento-box layouts and specific sports cards.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4FF00] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-[#BBE600] transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: bg-[#007AFF] text-white font-bold hover:bg-[#005BB5] transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-3
buttons.outline: border border-zinc-700 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white transition-colors rounded-md px-6 py-3

prediction_card.layout: Flex column, clear separation of event details vs odds.
prediction_card.elements: Sport icon, Team A vs Team B, Prediction Type (e.g., Over 2.5), Odds (Monospace), Tipster Avatar, Confidence Meter.

prop_bet_card.elements: Virtual Coin Stake input, Payout Calculator, Quick Bet buttons (Over/Under).

admin_panel.tables: Dense rows, monospaced data cells, status badges (Approved/Pending), action dropdowns.
admin_panel.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Left-aligned labels.

banner_zones.style: Subtle border, 'Ad' badge in corner, interactive hover states.

icons_and_assets.style: Duotone or bold variants for high visibility on dark backgrounds.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Interactive elements must lighten slightly on hover. No drastic color jumps. Active state scales down: active:scale-95.
motion_and_interaction.focus_states: Strict ring-2 ring-[#007AFF] on all form inputs and buttons for accessibility.

hero_background.description: Abstract neon green grid on dark background, used for Hero section with low opacity overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Strictly follow the color hex codes for the dark theme. Avoid standard generic colors. Use Neon Lime (#D4FF00) for primary CTAs like 'Bet Now' or 'Recharge', and Volt Blue for standard links.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Apply 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns) for testing (e.g., data-testid='place-bet-button').
instructions_to_main_agent.3: For the Admin Panel, implement a responsive Sidebar layout, and use Data Tables with monospaced text for numbers and amounts to ensure clean optical alignment.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The app is bilingual (ES/EN). Integrate a straightforward localization structure or context wrapper.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use generic text placeholder images. Strictly use the provided URLs in 'media_urls' for sports categories and hero sections.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Install required font families (Barlow Condensed, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts in index.html.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not center everything. Align content strictly to grids. Asymmetry and structured alignment create a premium feel.
